# Poe2BackpackItemInfo

[API index](../index)

One backpack item projected to plain script data (the facade-data equivalent of iterating the C#
`Inventory.Backpack` server inventory). Grid position + size come from the server slot; name /
corruption come from the item entity's `Base` component. `ItemAddress` is the backing item-entity
address, so a script can correlate a backpack item with a ground/entity read.

## Item

```typescript
Item?: Entity | null;
```

The live in-game item entity — the real object a script should read, not a snapshot.
`ItemAddress` stays as a denormalized convenience scalar for cross-correlation.
